interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A synthetic source-review, reproducible-build, artifact-provenance, and execution-attestation control separating one complete-looking public assurance surface from eight incompatible review-scope, build, independent-reproduction, signature, transparency, revocation, execution, and lineage states.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A real source-code review, reproducible-build result, artifact signature or provenance verification, transparency-log validation, execution attestation, security finding, interval-validity finding, causal effect, graph fact, allegation, or public-authority verdict.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: Verified-looking source-review, build, provenance, and execution-attestation badges do not establish complete review scope, independent byte reproduction, current unrevoked signature and provenance scope, package and entry-point identity, or a reconciled reviewed-source-to-output chain.

worlds.description: Reviewed source, reproducible build, independent byte reproduction, artifact signature and provenance, package and entry-point identity, source-to-output execution attestation, correction, and current lineage are complete.

The public source-review badge is unchanged although the reviewed commit, parent, tree, files, blobs, diff, approvals, submodules, vendored sources, generated inputs, patch series, or source export is incomplete or not used by the build.

The public reproducible-build badge is unchanged although the build graph, target, toolchain, compiler, linker, flags, optimization, timestamps, hermeticity, network policy, environment, generated inputs, logs, or primary artifact diverges.

A second build is reported as reproduction although builder independence, clean-room state, identical materials and toolchain, complete attempts and logs, byte comparison, divergence disposition, rerun custody, or verification is absent.
The artifact digest and signature are unchanged although the package, executable, entry point, or generated resource set invoked by the release differs from the signed artifact subject.

The public provenance badge is unchanged although signature, signer, key, delegation, statement scope, subjects, materials, predicate, transparency inclusion, expiry, or revocation custody is incomplete or stale.

The public execution-attestation badge is unchanged although the source-to-build, build-to-artifact, artifact-to-package, package-to-entry-point, invocation, executed-bytes, output, correction, rollback, withdrawal, or receipt chain is incomplete.

Historical review, build, reproduction, provenance, and execution-attestation assurance is inherited after source, recipe, toolchain, builder, artifact, signer, provenance, package, entry point, release, correction, or use succession.
